scope: Read-only source, static diff/AST, concrete canonical-record equality and recorded offline-test review. The reviewer did not import or execute the activation helper, issue Linux/operator commands, mutate product source, or commit.
reviewedGates: Exact helper/admission/four-record hashes, nested deployment outer/remote/core success and source/image/container preservation gates.
Exact accepted observer envelope, nested identities/health, source-run correlation and timezone-aware age from 0 to 1200 seconds.
Current app/gateway identity and zero app restarts; current relevant config/store bind resolved using every ancestor of the actual container package store.
Pinned runtime configuration bytes are hashed without parsing or printing, before mutation and after acceptance.
Exact prior unit bytes/mode/root ownership and no drop-ins; private prior-byte backup; only the single immutable image argument changes.
Unchanged broker bytes and effective static service properties; named timer targets only the reviewed service.
Fresh absent synthetic tenant/upload path, pinned generated input archive, exclusive writes, request published atomically last while future timer triggers are paused.
Normal timer-driven execution only; 90-second result bound and 50-second broker-drain bounds; no manual compiler invocation or active broker termination.
Timer advances, broker completes inactive/success/exit0, actual owned result/bundle source/output digests and media validation pass before cleanup.
Cleanup checks exact owned directory/file types, exact file-name set and original/input/output hashes; removes only owned files and empty directories.
Failures restore exact prior unit when guarded, preserve active work and published inputs when outcome is ambiguous, and verify effective rollback state before reporting it.
Final timer is enabled/active, final worker image/static properties and app/runtime/cache identities are rechecked, and an already failed broker cannot produce PASS.
No executable-runtime activation, account installation, application restart, customer-job inspection, queue pruning or live data restore is present.
resolvedFindings: Original draft admitted only outer deployment exit and observer passed bit; full nested accepted-release checks were added.
Original draft lacked observer freshness and current runtime-byte verification; both are now enforced.
Original mount lookup could miss a deeper package-store override; lookup now uses the actual store ancestor chain.
Original cleanup could race an active broker; future triggers now pause and the existing broker drains before validation/cleanup.
Partial cleanup formerly trusted recomputed hashes; it now compares original input pins.
Timer-stop intent, unknown-unit rollback guards and effective restored-service checks now prevent misleading restoration claims.
Timer target and final restarted-service health are checked; retained-fixture and late-error reports reflect the observed state.

execution.condition: Root may use only these exact reviewed bytes and admission pin while all runtime gates still pass; an expired observer requires a new accepted observation and hash-bound admission.
